title: Vendor escalation becomes a ticket graveyard

retrieve_on.symptom_narrative: The internet provider wants wired tests; the application vendor wants logs. Our notes rarely say where or when tests occurred. Second technicians repeat them. An access point replacement did not fix a meeting-room problem that returned during busy events. Waiting for vendor can last indefinitely.
retrieve_on.workflow_context: Ten-person office network, Wi-Fi and general IT service provider.

discriminating_questions.question: Which conditions reproduce the issue?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Busy meetings, but tests were done in an empty room.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: A supplier may have a real unresolved external defect; the service firm can manage evidence and communications without claiming to fix it.

discriminating_questions.question: Are results timestamped and tied to a device?
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: Who follows up with the vendor?
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: Was the workaround verified under original conditions?
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

positive_mechanism: Evidence lacks reproducible context and escalations lose accountable ownership.
counterexample: A supplier may have a real unresolved external defect; the service firm can manage evidence and communications without claiming to fix it.
minimum_evidence: A simulated test log omits load conditions.
A simulated vendor request remains unanswered.
A simulated closure note records only temporary restoration.
process_intervention: Record test context, results and next vendor action; separate restored, monitoring and resolved states.
automation_candidate: Build structured investigation timelines and vendor follow-up tasks; draft evidence packages with sensitive information removed.
unknowns: Supplier support windows and permissible diagnostic data vary by agreement.
stop_rule: If discriminating evidence is absent or conflicting, return an unresolved hypothesis plus a targeted question, not a confident solution.

capability_boundary.proposed_extension: Structured technical investigation and supplier-case linking are additional capabilities.
capability_boundary.pricing: No price assigned; current rate card must not be extended by analogy.
